paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Software Developer with 5+ years of experience building scalable enterprise web applications. I specialize in .NET (C#) backends and React/TypeScript frontends, with hands-on experience in ERP systems, SaaS platforms, and RESTful API design.

experience.description: Contributed to Reganalytics — a tax analytics SaaS platform — developing the Regbrief briefing app, Company Data org-chart tool, and a customized mailing system using yFiles for interactive visualizations.
responsibilities: Built scalable, high-performance web applications using .NET Core and React.
Developed key features of the Reganalytics tax analytics platform, including Regbrief and Company Data modules.
Collaborated with stakeholders, product managers and UX/UI designers to define requirements and enhance the software development process.
Managed the full lifecycle of software projects — planning, executing, and monitoring from start to finish.

experience.description: Delivered ERP modules for AKIJ, Apon Wellbeing Ltd. and Madina Group. Built Procurement, Inventory, Notification, and Approval Management systems on top of a shared .NET Core platform.
responsibilities: Built and maintained ERP modules for Procurement, Inventory and Approval Management.
Developed RESTful APIs using .NET Core (C#) for ERP integration.
Implemented new features, resolved bugs, and optimized application performance.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver client-specific solutions.

projects.title: RegAnalytics
projects.description: Enterprise tax analytics SaaS platform delivering regulatory compliance tools including Regbrief (tax-news briefing) and Company Data (org-chart analysis) for global clients.

projects.title: Akij ERP
projects.description: Full-featured Enterprise Resource Planning software covering Procurement, Inventory, Approval workflows, and Notification systems for multiple large Bangladeshi conglomerates.
